opus.problem: The two sons are not in Exodus 18:2, which says only that Jethro had received Zipporah. The sons come from Exodus 18:3, so the clue is not fully supported by its cited verse.

Moses' father-in-law is also called Reuel (Exodus 2:18). Several clues describe him only as Moses' father-in-law or a priest of Midian, so a baker could fairly answer Reuel for the same person. Either add Reuel to the accepted answers or make sure the clues point only to the name Jethro.
